column1: # spec-ownership.tsv — scope gate for the intent router.
# Format:  marker <TAB> owning_spec_id <TAB> human topic label
# WHAT THIS IS FOR
# Retrieval scores cannot tell you that a question is unanswerable. Measured on
# this corpus (2026-07-27), questions whose owning spec is ABSENT scored *higher*
# than questions that were answered correctly — median top score 0.905 vs 0.780 —
# because with no true owner competing, one loosely-related chunk wins uncontested.
# So a threshold can never detect this. The server has to know what it is missing.
# When a marker below matches the query, ThreeGppToolService checks whether the
# owning spec is actually indexed. If it is NOT, the search is short-circuited and
# the caller is told which spec they need and to use WebSearch. If the spec IS
# indexed, the marker is ignored entirely — so ingesting 29.244 automatically
# disables the PFCP entries here with no code or config change.
# RULES FOR ADDING A MARKER
# 1. Only add a marker when NO indexed spec could reasonably answer the question.
#    Counter-example: do NOT gate "Nsmf_PDUSession" on 29.502 — 23.502 IS indexed
#    and legitimately defines those service operations at stage 2.
#    Counter-example: do NOT gate "s-cscf" on 24.229 — 23.228 IS indexed and
#    covers IMS architecture including CSCF roles.
# 2. Markers are matched case-insensitively on word boundaries, so "n4" will not
#    match inside "n40" and "cdr" will not match inside "cdrom".
# 3. Prefer multi-word markers; single short tokens are the main false-positive risk.
# 4. After editing, re-run bench/run_bench.py. A marker that fires on an
#    answerable question turns a correct result into a refusal — the worst
#    possible regression. The current set was validated at 0 false positives
#    across all 100 benchmark questions.
# ── PFCP / N4 — TS 29.244 absent; nothing indexed covers the N4 protocol ──────
pfcp
n4 session
sxa
sxb
# ── Charging — the entire 32.24x/32.29x charging family is absent ─────────────
charging data record
cdr
offline charging
online charging
# ── IMS stage 3 — TS 24.229 absent. Only gate SIP-protocol-level markers;
#    IMS architecture questions are answerable from 23.228 / 23.167 / 23.237. ──
sip invite
sip method
sip response code
# ── GTP-U user plane — TS 29.281 absent (29.274 is GTPv2-C, control plane) ────
gtp-u extension header
# ── Pseudowire / L2VPN — IETF, and none of the owning RFCs are indexed ────────
# Added 2026-07-28. "VPN Pseudowire Down leading to Link Down" returned 23.060,
# 23.007, 29.274 and 23.501 — 3GPP specs for a topic 3GPP does not cover (0
# chunks mention pseudowire). RFC 2863 does explain how a lower sub-layer going
# down propagates linkDown upward, which is the generic half of the answer, but
# the PW-specific status mapping lives in RFCs we do not hold.
pseudowire
pseudo-wire
pwe3
pw status
